title: Holy Post -  Race in America
summary: Phil Vischer of VeggieTales and Holy Post gives an 18-minute history of racial injustice in America, covering why anger persists despite civil rights laws. It is told from an evangelical Christian perspective and adapted from a class he co-taught.
why: Recommended as a concise, broad-strokes history of racial injustice, including the lasting effects of redlining.
topic: history of racial injustice in america

quote.text: There’s a great 18-minute video from Bob the Tomato, AKA Phil Vischer, which lays out the sordid history in broad detail.
